concepts.why: The presence of a large polypoid mass obstructing the left nasal cavity, CD138-positive and CD56-positive immunophenotype, and EBV-positive status are consistent with Extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma, nasal type.
The gains of florescence signal at multiple loci, including 3q27 (BCL6), 8q24 (MYC), and 14q32 (IGH), are consistent with Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma.
The presence of a large polypoid mass obstructing the left nasal cavity and CD138-positive and CD56-positive immunophenotype are consistent with Peripheral T-cell lymphoma.

The presence of a large polypoid mass obstructing the left nasal cavity, CD138-positive and CD56-positive immunophenotype, and EBV-positive status are consistent with Nasal natural killer cell lymphoma.
The 12-month history of left-sided nasal congestion and obstruction is consistent with Chronic rhinosinusitis.
The 12-month history of left-sided nasal congestion and obstruction could be consistent with Allergic rhinitis.
The presence of a large polypoid mass obstructing the left nasal cavity is consistent with Nasal polyp.
The 12-month history of left-sided nasal congestion and obstruction and the presence of a large polypoid mass obstructing the left nasal cavity could be consistent with Invasive fungal sinusitis.
It explains the CD20-negative and PAX5-negative findings in the context of a lymphoma with specific genetic alterations.
